tasks.title: Test-harness determinism — per-process pytest DB path and a load-proof D10/D13 overshoot assertion
tasks.description: Two harness defects redden suites wave-wide and hand the Code Reviewer false failures. (1) PRIMARY: `tests/conftest.py:8-13` derives ONE hard-coded temp DB path (`tempfile.gettempdir()/tos_charting_test.sqlite3`) and `os.remove()`s it at import, so every concurrent pytest process opens, deletes and commits against the same file. With up to ~20 Build Workers in a wave this raises `sqlite3.OperationalError: attempt to write a readonly database` (SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED) in the autouse `_isolate_test_db` teardown while the test BODIES pass. Reported independently by five wave workers — P1-T35, P1-T36, P1-T38, P1-T41 and P1-T43 (`done`) — verbatim: "the raw command's failures are cross-worker shared-temp-DB contention, not assertions"; "concurrent wave workers share the hard-coded temp DB path"; "with a private TMPDIR the run is deterministically 4 passed". Fix: the DB path must be unique per process (PID and/or a per-process temp directory) and no process may remove a path it did not create. (2) SECONDARY: `test_T28_T01_volume_hidden_and_watchlist_max_clamp_keeps_price_panel` (`tests/test_d10_d13_integration.py`) asserts a chart width after an overshoot drag and can observe the PRE-clamp value (`assert 88 >= 400`) under system load, because `MainWindow._deferred_dock_clamp` re-clamps through chained `QTimer.singleShot(0)` callbacks that may not have run when the assertion fires. It is pre-existing and load-dependent, not a product bug: it failed in P1-T41's BASELINE run before that task's edit, and passes 20/20 with no concurrent load. Fix the DETERMINISM in the test (bounded drain / settled-wait before the final assert) — do not weaken, skip or xfail the assertions. Work order: the conftest DB isolation first (it reddens the most suites), then the timing flake. Scope guard: test-harness hygiene ONLY — no production module is edited, no new component, no shim, no change to the approved D41 design (decision S12 is the standing testing standard this conforms to). If determinism provably cannot be reached from the test side, STOP and report it as a plan-level question (see `docs/tasks/task_manager_notes.md`) rather than editing `ui/main_window.py`.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — harness invariant, per-process DB (S12; the ESC-024/025 gotcha) — Given `tests/conftest.py` after the change, When any pytest process starts, Then the SQLite file it exports as `DB_PATH` is unique to that process (its name and/or its directory is derived from the process — `os.getpid()` and/or a per-process temp directory created for it), the module no longer `os.remove()`s a fixed shared path, and the autouse `_isolate_test_db` fixture's wipe behaviour (its table list and post-test wipe) is unchanged.

AC2 — the defect itself, concurrency acceptance — Given two pytest processes of the same DB-touching suite started simultaneously from the repo root, When both finish, Then both exit 0 and neither log contains `attempt to write a readonly database` / SQLITE_READONLY_DBMOVED; this holds for 3 consecutive pair-runs (the pre-fix harness fails this class of run, and every other test-executing task in this graph depends on this task for exactly that reason).

AC3 — timing determinism, assertion unchanged — Given `test_T28_T01_volume_hidden_and_watchlist_max_clamp_keeps_price_panel` after its overshoot `_drag_watchlist_to(win, max_w + 1000, qapp)`, When it proceeds to its width assertions, Then it has drained the deferred dock clamp (pending `QTimer.singleShot(0)` callbacks processed / a bounded settled-wait — bounded, never an unbounded loop) before asserting, and the assertions remain `assert cp.width() >= CHART_MIN_WIDTH` and `assert cp.price_plot.width() >= CHART_MIN_WIDTH` — not weakened, narrowed, skipped, xfailed or deleted; the test passes >=3 consecutive runs while a concurrent pytest process loads the machine.
